prediction.question: 拾った銀色の栞が、持ち主の記憶を呼び覚ますとしたら？
options: 少年の過去の断片が見える
図書室の景色が一変する
栞が光り、誰かの声が響く

en.title: In the Waning Indigo Night
en.premise: Where the lights of a sleepless city melt into the sound of the waves. In the school library after hours, I encounter a mysterious boy who is said to appear only on the night of a lunar eclipse. He possesses the power to trap someone's memories within the shadow of the waning moon. At the edge of the silent night, the boundary between us slowly begins to blur.

zh.title: 在靛蓝色的渐缺之夜
zh.premise: 那是灯火不眠的城市，与浪潮之声交融之处。在放学后的图书馆里，我遇见了一个据说只会在月食之夜出现的奇妙少年。他拥有将某人的记忆，封印在渐缺月影中的力量。在寂静的夜晚边缘，两人的界限正缓缓模糊。
